description: This file is a shell script that contains a set of tests for verifying the 'safe.directory' feature in Git, especially when running with elevated privileges (as root) using sudo. It includes setup procedures, prerequisite checks, and various test cases to ensure correct behavior of Git in different ownership and permission scenarios.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a specific prerequisite before running the tests.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Performs a lazy prerequisite check involving SUDO and git commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: run_with_sudo
methods.description: Executes a block of commands with elevated privileges using sudo.
